name: plan-execution
title: Plan Execution
summary: Execute a confirmed plan to completion with per-task proof, review gates, and ledgered rulings.

use_when: A confirmed implementation plan or task breakdown exists and the user wants it executed
The harness offers subagents and the plan has mostly independent tasks — or execution must run inline
Several independent problem domains can be worked in parallel
avoid_when: No confirmed plan exists — use task-planning or spec-writing
Requirements or scope are still unclear — use discovery
The work is one trivial task that needs no plan
